outcome: Postoperative recovery (time to uterine recovery, first defecation, first bowel movement, getting out of bed, and length of hospital stay)
cohort: 198 women who underwent cesarean section at a hospital in China between January 1 and December 31, 2021
finding: Rapid rehabilitation care after cesarean section was associated with reduced pain, faster recovery, improved lactation, and better psychological well-being compared to conventional care.
